config.tunnelUrl: URL of the backend tunnel (e.g. https://xxx.trycloudflare.com)
config.token: Bearer token (CLOUD_TOKEN). Be careful with Settings Sync.
config.healthPollSeconds: How often the status bar polls /health, in seconds
config.search.provider: Backend for the web_search tool. duckduckgo needs no key but is scraped and can break; brave and searxng use an API.
config.search.apiKey: Brave Search API key (provider = brave). Not synced safely: prefer user settings.
config.search.url: Base URL of a SearXNG instance with format=json enabled (provider = searxng).
